router.credit: current token CE + next logical chunk mean CE (beta=1); truncated even across TBPTT boundary via detached lookahead
router.gradient: per-action detached(current target CE + next chunk mean CE - old baseline[step]) times logprob; global action mean; beta=1
router.baseline_commit: two old step baselines frozen throughout optimizer group; EMA .98 updated from group mean returns only after successful step

budget.complete_document_rule: largest full-group prefix <= candidate; minimum actual 250K unchanged; ineligible rounded lowest candidate is reported explicitly

initialization: forked same seed for common M0/M1/M2 components; new state and state-router modules independent seed

precision_policy.overflow: FP32 nonfinite loss/gradient fails before optimizer.step; restore RNG and discard group baseline/counters; no blind retries. Post-step nonfinite params invalidate run and are not checkpointed.

gradient_horizon.state_and_kv: two logical chunks, backward once per nonoverlapping window; detach after window
gradient_horizon.T0: standard causal self-attention includes current input Token, no future Token; all layer KV detached at each chunk boundary
gradient_horizon.optimizer_group: CE sum/group valid targets + .1 PG sum/(2*group valid targets); backward per H=2 window, optimizer step only after complete document group
gradient_horizon.state_update: shared tanh Linear(3d,state_dim) proposals, scatter mean per cell, shared GRU(state_dim,state_dim), frozen snapshot in both steps; commit only at logical boundary or explicit document finish

ablations.cell_off: replace CellCore State input by zero; preserve state updates and Router
ablations.router_off: zero W_S*s term only; M2 only
ablations.recurrence_off: replace GRU old-state argument by zero, preserve h_before/u and write
ablations.all_off: cell_off + router_off + recurrence_off; no claim distinct predictive content beyond cell_off+router_off
ablations.write_off: keep zero initial State by preventing all updates
ablations.reset_chunk: reset numerical State at chunk starts; not KV
ablations.shuffle: cyclic shift by one in CellCore State reads only; Router mapping unchanged

holdout_policy: separate dataset validation subset used for development selection; independent holdout not loaded

benchmark.selection: prefer 64 when feasible; otherwise fastest feasible four-model aggregate; no quality-based selection

scope: new input-KV chunk-parallel mechanism, not numerical/kernel-equivalent to v0.2
